papers.title: MMKG-R1: Constructing Multimodal Knowledge Graphs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) organize information across different modalities to support multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which aims to improve the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The effectiveness of these multimodal Graph RAG methods largely depends on the quality of the constructed MMKGs. However, most existing methods construct MMKGs without explicit guidance on graph quality, while reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods that rely on final-answer correctness may provide only indirect feedback on MMKG quality. To address these limitations, we propose MMKG-R1, a novel MMKG-quality-driven RL framework for training an MLLM as a multimodal knowledge constructor. To be specific, MMKG-R1 introduces multiple quality-aware rewards to directly evaluate both the quality of information extracted from individual knowledge sources and the quality of the assembled MMKG. These rewards are then used to guide the RL training. Experiments across multiple datasets show that MMKG-R1 constructs MMKGs that improve downstream question-answering accuracy.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MMKG-R1，一个以 MMKG 质量为导向的强化学习框架，训练 MLLM 作为多模态知识构造器，通过显式质量奖励提升所构建 MMKG 向下游问答的可用性。
summary.methods: 构建 MLLM 多模态知识构造器；设计多个质量感知奖励，分别直接评估从单个知识源抽取信息的质量与组装后 MMKG 的质量，并用于指导 RL 训练；在多个数据集上进行实验，评估下游问答准确率。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、检索增强与对齐、知识图谱、强化学习、多模态学习”主题相关，因为其关注多模态知识图谱构建质量与多模态 Graph RAG 的检索增强效果，并用强化学习优化构造过程。
summary.caveat: 摘要只说明实验显示下游问答准确率提升，未给出具体数据集、基线、提升幅度或消融结果；也未说明质量奖励的具体定义与 RL 算法细节。

papers.title: On the Limits of Representation-Based Test-Time Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Vision-language models suffer significant accuracy drops under common corruptions. While test-time adaptation (TTA) successfully mitigates these shifts in CLIP-like contrastive models, its application to generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains underexplored and uniquely challenging due to their sequential token generation. In this work, we demonstrate that representation-based TTA fails to recover performance in MLLMs. Our experiments reveal that even when violating standard TTA assumptions by leveraging target data offline, sample-blind feature alignment recovers only marginal accuracy. We attribute this failure to the nature of corruption shifts: unlike CLIP-like architectures, which benefit from a shared domain-shift direction within a single pooled classification embedding, MLLM visual token sequence shifts are nearly orthogonal and span the full embedding space.These findings bound what any sample-blind, position-shared correction at a single encoder site can achieve, establishing that representation-space interventions alone might be insufficient to ensure corruption robustness in MLLMs.

summary.takeaway: 研究表明，基于表示空间测试时适应（representation-based TTA）在生成式多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中难以恢复常见损坏带来的性能下降。
summary.methods: 分析 MLLMs 在常见损坏下的精度下降；尝试 representation-based TTA，并在违反标准 TTA 假设、离线利用目标数据的情况下测试 sample-blind 特征对齐；通过分析视觉 token 序列偏移的几何性质解释失败原因。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、持续适应与预训练、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成、检索增强与对齐”相关，因为其讨论 MLLMs 的鲁棒性适应，并指出表示空间干预在生成式多模态模型中的边界。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体 MLLM、损坏类型、数据集、精度数值或对比基线；结论主要限定于 sample-blind、位置共享、单一编码器位置的表示修正。

papers.title: MicroCLIP: Connecting Text and Microscopy Images via Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining
papers.abstract: Understanding fluorescence microscopy images is fundamental to automating biological research. However, existing methods typically learn predefined concepts from closed-set data, limiting transfer across tasks and biological contexts. In this work, we introduce MicroCLIP, a vision-language model that learns generalizable cellular and subcellular representations from natural language supervision for open-set image classification and retrieval. To pretrain MicroCLIP, we construct MicroPool-2M, a dataset of approximately 2.5 million fluorescence microscopy image-text pairs spanning diverse cellular structures, cell lines, and imaging conditions. Aligning microscopy images with biological concepts in natural language is challenging because most images lack descriptive captions and biological knowledge annotations. We therefore progressively establish image-text associations at three levels to provide MicroCLIP with richer semantic supervision: (1) category-level alignment links images to standardized labels defined by subcellular structure-cell-line combinations; (2) knowledge-level alignment incorporates biological priors derived from these labels to capture relationships across species and cell types; and (3) detail-level alignment uses a multimodal large language model to recaption and verify image-text pairs at scale, emphasizing fine-grained visual characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroCLIP achieves leading performance in zero-shot classification and text-image retrieval on microscopy images. It retrieves images with specific cellular characteristics from thousands of candidates and generalizes to unseen biological concepts without additional supervision. These results highlight MicroCLIP's potential as a foundation model for fluorescence microscopy.

summary.takeaway: 提出 MicroCLIP，一个通过自然语言监督学习可泛化细胞与亚细胞表示的视觉-语言模型，用于荧光显微图像的开放集分类与检索。
summary.methods: 构建 MicroPool-2M 数据集，包含约 250 万荧光显微图像-文本对；在类别级、知识级和细节级三个层次建立图像-文本关联，其中细节级使用多模态大语言模型重描述并验证图文对；在零样本分类和文本-图像检索任务上实验。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、预训练、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成”相关，因为其属于显微图像领域的视觉-语言预训练与跨模态对齐，并利用 MLLM 辅助数据构建。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体模型规模、训练细节、基线对比数值和失败场景；2.5M 图文对中自动重描述质量对结果的影响未被量化。

papers.title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GeoReader，让 VLM 学习可读取的潜在几何表示：先训练轻量 Geometric Readers 生成连续输入 token，再冻结 Readers 微调 VLM 用于空间问答。
summary.methods: 使用冻结 VLM 解码的几何描述监督 Geometric Readers，使其以目标模型可读形式表达几何；随后冻结 Readers 并在空间 QA 上微调 VLM，几何注入以问题为条件；推理时直接从连续几何 token 回答，不生成几何链式思考。基于 RGB 预测几何，并报告 MindCube-Tiny 和六个额外空间基准上的结果。
summary.relevance: 与“检索增强与对齐、预训练、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成”相关，因为其关注 VLM 的空间推理瓶颈、几何表示与语言模型潜在空间的对齐及跨模态信息注入。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出与所有基线的完整对比、统计显著性或消融细节；其核心论断“仅能重建几何不等于模型会使用几何”主要基于所考察的 feature-alignment 模型。

papers.title: Beyond the Final Layer: Evaluating Single-Cell Foundation Model Representations for Molecular Prediction
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are commonly benchmarked using final-layer embeddings, although useful depth may depend on the task. We evaluate Geneformer, scBERT, scGPT, and scFoundation as frozen feature extractors for cell-type and perturbation-response prediction using layer-wise probes, leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) selection, readout controls, representation diagnostics, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and retrieval/collapse analyses. Intermediate layers significantly improve cell-type accuracy for scGPT and scBERT in several settings, while Geneformer and scFoundation generally show performance comparable to their final layers. For perturbation prediction, LODO identifies layer 1 as an earliest-on-par candidate across all four models, without establishing universal superiority. Paired scGPT CLS and mean-pooling analyses show that readout affects preferred depth. CKA and representation metrics reveal model- and task-dependent geometric changes, while retrieval and collapse checks support the robustness of perturbation findings. We recommend reporting extraction depth, readout, selection protocol, and task-specific diagnostics. A validated non-final layer may also reduce computation, although efficiency was not directly benchmarked.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估单细胞基础模型中间层表示在细胞类型与扰动响应预测中的价值，发现非最终层在某些任务和模型上更优，尤其扰动预测中 layer 1 被 LODO 选为最早可用候选。
summary.methods: 以 Geneformer、scBERT、scGPT、scFoundation 作为冻结特征提取器；采用逐层探针、leave-one-dataset-out（LODO）选择、读出控制、表示诊断、CKA 和检索/collapse 分析，评估细胞类型与扰动响应预测。
summary.relevance: 与“单细胞扰动、Cell Foundation Model、预训练”直接相关，因为其研究单细胞基础模型表示的可用深度、读出头和选择协议对分子预测的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体准确率、数据集名称或效应大小；作者明确不声称 layer 1 具有普遍优越性，且未直接基准测试计算效率；结论依赖于所选探针和 LODO 协议。

papers.title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

summary.takeaway: 对多模态大语言模型空间推理微调的数据中心视角进行综述，按数据集设计、数据集构建与评估组织研究，并总结固定空间标注的四类构建方法及评估多样性。
summary.methods: 综述监督微调到强化学习等后训练方法，重点分析所用数据集；归纳数据集构建主题，包括数据模态、标注与评估；将研究分为数据集设计、数据集构建和评估三类；总结规则与模板、LLM prompting、程序生成和 human-in-the-loop 四种固定空间标注构建方法。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、强化学习、多模态学习”相关，因为其聚焦 MLLM 空间推理能力的数据驱动后训练与评估，涉及具身智能和机器人视觉任务。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，摘要未提供新的实验结果或定量综合；其分类和未来方向基于所检文献范围，可能未覆盖所有最新工作。

papers.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SP$^2$ec，一种免训练的多臂老虎机算法，可在生成过程中自适应选择自推测解码的 draft 配置，以提升 VLM 推理吞吐并最小化墙钟时间 regret。
summary.methods: 利用现有自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，包括 SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM 和简单的 cosSim；为每个查询设计墙钟时间 regret 并给出理论保证；在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 和 LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B 上跨视觉与文本任务实验。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成”相关，因为其针对 VLM 推理加速，属于多模态大模型的高效生成与解码优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要只报告相较原始自推测方法最高 11% 的提升，未列出完整基线、任务细节、硬件设置或 regret 保证的具体常数；实际加速可能受实现和部署环境影响。

papers.title: DVTR-KD: Distilling Vision-Language Models via Intermediate Visual Token Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse vision-language tasks, but their computational demands limit deployment under constrained budgets, particularly on edge devices. Many works focus on Knowledge Distillation (KD) and try to transfer knowledge from powerful teacher models to students. In addition to reducing model size, visual token compression provides a complementary route to efficiency, but introduces mismatched visual token counts that complicate direct token-wise knowledge transfer. To mitigate this, we propose DVTR-KD, a knowledge distillation framework based on \textbf{D}ense \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}oken \textbf{R}econstruction, which reconstructs the teacher's dense visual tokens from the student's compressed tokens. We reconstruct visual states after the final LLM layer and at the input to an intermediate layer identified as important for visual-information readout. At the intermediate layer, reconstruction is supervised through the teacher's response predictions rather than by direct token-wise KL or MSE matching. An auxiliary attention-readout loss complements this response-level supervision by aligning how the student and the original teacher integrate contextual information when predicting responses. Evaluations on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DVTR-KD improves the performance of token-compressed students while retaining the inference efficiency afforded by visual token compression.

summary.takeaway: 提出 DVTR-KD，一种基于稠密视觉 token 重建的知识蒸馏框架，将教师模型的稠密视觉 token 信息迁移到使用压缩视觉 token 的学生模型，以在保持推理效率的同时提升性能。
summary.methods: 从学生压缩 token 重建教师稠密视觉 token；重建发生在 LLM 最终层之后以及被识别为视觉信息读出重要的中间层输入处；中间层重建由教师响应预测监督，而非直接 token-wise KL 或 MSE；辅以 attention-readout 损失对齐学生与教师整合上下文信息的方式；在多种基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成”相关，因为其面向 MLLM 的知识蒸馏与视觉 token 压缩，关注视觉信息在语言模型中的传递与读出。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体基准名称、学生模型规模、压缩率、对比方法或性能数值；中间层重要性的识别方法和 attention-readout 损失的细节未被展开。

papers.title: QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

summary.takeaway: 提出QORH，将查询相关规则头与有序规则体编码为超边，以联合建模多关系依赖，从而支持归纳式知识图谱链接预测。
summary.methods: 以查询关系为条件，把规则头和有序规则体表示为超边；利用规则置信度、覆盖率等统计证据进行可学习规则选择；通过角色感知的超图消息传递增强关系表示以指导实体级推理；模型共享参数不依赖具体实体或关系标识。
summary.relevance: 直接对应知识图谱与图谱构建与表示主题，关注知识图谱链接预测中的推理模式学习与归纳能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在实体归纳和完全归纳基准上优于所评估的基线，未给出具体数据集、指标数值或消融细节。

papers.title: GraphRAG-LTM: A Layered Threat Modeling Framework for Attacks on Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) uses document-derived knowledge graphs to assemble evidence for large language model (LLM) answers. Its security depends on both the seed chunks retrieved for a query and the graph evidence assembled from them, yet attacks on this evidence path remain underexplored. We introduce GraphRAG-LTM, a Layered Threat Modeling framework that tests three nested levels of attacker access. BB Query uses ranking feedback to make query edits under a semantic-similarity constraint and demote relevant seed chunks. WB Query uses retriever gradients for the same objective. Graph-aware WB keeps the white-box adversarial query and deletes bridge triplets from the query-specific evidence graph, disrupting multi-hop evidence propagation through localized graph edits. Across datasets, retrievers, and LLM backbones, rank feedback alone reduces answer quality, gradient access strengthens query attacks, and bridge-triplet deletion further impairs supporting-fact retrieval. Further analyses show how seed retrieval and graph evidence jointly contribute to these failures.

summary.takeaway: 提出GraphRAG-LTM，对GraphRAG证据路径上的查询与图证据攻击进行三层威胁建模，并显示不同访问级别可逐级降低答案质量。
summary.methods: 设置三种嵌套攻击者权限：BB Query利用排序反馈在语义相似度约束下编辑查询以压低相关种子块；WB Query利用检索器梯度实现同一目标；Graph-aware WB在保留白盒对抗查询的同时删除查询特定证据图中的桥接三元组以破坏多跳证据传播；跨数据集、检索器和LLM骨干评估。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强与对齐、大语言模型和知识图谱相关，直接研究GraphRAG系统的安全与鲁棒性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体数据集、检索器、LLM骨干名称及量化结果，也未说明防御措施。

papers.title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
papers.abstract: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

summary.takeaway: 评估五个LLM在360个英文叙事上重建Allen 13种区间关系完整网络的能力，发现结构化输出可靠性与相对时间处理仍是瓶颈。
summary.methods: 让五个LLM对360个英文叙事中事件重建完整Allen区间关系网络；使用预注册协议评估与金标注释的一致性、逆关系一致性和逻辑可满足性；并进行解析后处理分析。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型评估与图谱构建/表示中时序关系抽取话题，关注事件时间关系与逻辑一致性。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出整体最佳模型在宏F1上超过平凡基线，但在预注册解析器下没有模型超过始终回答“before”的准确率；解析伪影影响较大，后验解析器将覆盖率从0.60提升到0.84并缩小差距；逻辑一致性对金标一致性的指示有限。

papers.title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.

summary.takeaway: 提出VLRLA，为已有VLA模型加入上下文强化学习能力，在部署时利用历史交互经验逐步改进动作生成而保持模型参数固定。
summary.methods: 在VLA模型上增加强化学习模块，从历史观测、动作、奖励和终止信号中学习；部署中不断精炼动作生成并提升任务成功率；设计上兼容多种学习历史构建策略与模型训练流程；在仿真和真实世界部署中实验。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与跨模态理解与生成，关注视觉-语言-动作模型在部署时的持续适应。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体仿真环境、真实机器人平台或定量成功率与对比数值，也未说明经验存储规模与安全性限制。

papers.title: Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment
papers.abstract: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shifts and their correlation with task outcomes. Our experiments show improved performance in 3 of 6 downstream tasks and comparable results in the others. Our Feature analysis reveals that, for segmentation tasks, continually pretrained encoder features exhibit greater similarity to those of the finetuned encoder than the original pretrained encoder, correlating with observed performance gains.

summary.takeaway: 探索对前列腺MRI ViT编码器进行持续预训练以增强任务对齐，并用CKA分析表示变化与下游性能的关系。
summary.methods: 在预训练ViT编码器上使用LoRA针对前列腺分割任务进行持续预训练；在6个下游任务上评估；使用Centered Kernel Alignment进行逐层表示分析，考察表示偏移与任务结果的相关性。
summary.relevance: 对应持续适应与预训练、预训练主题，关注医学影像基础模型的任务对齐问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称6个下游任务中3个提升、其余相当，但未列出具体任务、指标数值、数据集规模或统计显著性。

papers.title: Seeing at the Edge: Energy Characterization of Vision-Language Model Inference on Edge Platforms
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are moving onto edge devices, but little is known about how much energy they draw on single-board computers with NPU or GPU accelerators, or where that energy goes. We measure total-system energy, latency, and thermal behavior of Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct and its text-only sibling on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-10H NPU and on a Jetson Orin Nano Super, on both CPU and accelerator, and separate the fixed energy of each request from the energy that grows with output length. Because the accelerators use different quantization and serving software, we compare deployment stacks rather than silicon. Three findings stand out. First, NPU offloading makes the Pi a much more efficient VLM platform: it cuts energy per generated token by about two-thirds, leaves the host CPU largely free, and avoids the thermal throttling that the CPU backend reaches in sustained use. Second, an image adds both fixed and per-token energy, but at typical response lengths generating the answer costs far more than processing the image. Third, the Jetson GPU favors short responses through its lower fixed cost per request, whereas the Pi NPU favors longer ones through its lower cost per output token; their energy curves cross near 40 output tokens.

summary.takeaway: 测量Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct及其纯文本版本在Raspberry Pi 5+Hailo-10H NPU和Jetson Orin Nano Super上的系统能耗、时延和热行为，并区分固定能耗与随输出长度增长的能耗。
summary.methods: 在两种边缘平台上分别使用CPU与加速器部署VLM，测量总系统能耗、延迟和热行为；将每次请求的固定能耗与随输出长度增长的能耗分离；由于加速器量化和服务软件不同，比较部署栈而非硅片。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解与生成，关注VLM在边缘设备上的能效部署。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出相对趋势，如NPU卸载约降低每生成token能耗三分之二、能量曲线约在40输出token附近交叉，未提供绝对能耗数值、完整模型列表或统计误差。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Integrate Conflicting Evidence Like Biased Bayesian Observers
papers.abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile conflicting text and images. Prior work has characterized the resulting behavior in terms of modality biases--e.g., a "blind faith in text"--but why preferences vary across models, domains, and input conditions remains unclear. We develop a predictive account from a Bayesian perspective, positing that VLMs combine conditionally independent evidence from each modality with prior beliefs, subject to modality-specific biases. The resulting two-parameter cue combination model accurately predicts VLM preferences under unseen combinations of input degradation and transfers to new forms of unreliability without refitting. Separating evidence strength from integration bias explains how VLMs can follow text even while weighting visual evidence more heavily, reconciling reports of text and vision dominance under a single combination rule.

summary.takeaway: 从贝叶斯视角提出两参数线索组合模型，预测VLM在文本与图像冲突时如何整合条件独立证据与先验，并解释模态偏好差异。
summary.methods: 将VLM行为建模为对来自每个模态的条件独立证据与先验信念进行组合，并加入模态特定偏差；用两参数线索组合模型预测未见输入退化组合下的VLM偏好，并迁移到新型不可靠性而不重新拟合。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解与生成，关注视觉语言模型整合冲突证据的机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体VLM、数据集、任务或预测准确率数值，也未展开模型假设的适用范围。

papers.title: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.

summary.takeaway: 提出XferAgent，通过本地与共享经验图组织可复用经验，在异构LLM智能体之间转移经验并避免不可靠合并。
summary.methods: 在本地和共享经验图中组织可复用经验；调和异构智能体的兼容贡献并避免不可靠合并；针对新任务选择共享经验并与目标智能体本地经验整合以支持执行；在多种任务域实验。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强与对齐，关注LLM智能体的经验复用与跨智能体迁移。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体任务域、基线方法名称、成功率数值或共享经验图的构建与冲突解决细节。

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Average-reward Q-learning with Options
papers.abstract: We study the finite-sample convergence of Q-learning algorithms for the average-reward formulation of Reinforcement Learning (RL) with options. While options allow temporarily extended and hierarchical actions, the average-reward formulation incorporates continual tasks beyond discounted and episodic RL. We establish the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both the inter- and intra-option settings. First, we prove that both inter- and intra-option Bellman operators satisfy multi-step span contractions under unichain assumptions. Then, we propose synchronous estimators of these multi-step option Bellman operators leading to two variants of option Q-learning. Finally, we extend the stochastic approximation framework to prove convergence rates of these two algorithms under the minimal assumptions used in the literature.

summary.takeaway: 首次为平均奖励（average-reward）设定下的option Q-learning给出有限样本、均方意义下的收敛速率保证，涵盖inter-option与intra-option两种设置。
summary.methods: 证明inter-和intra-option Bellman算子满足多步span收缩（unichain假设），据此提出这两种算子的同步估计器，得到两个option Q-learning变体，并扩展随机逼近框架证明其收敛速率。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于强化学习理论与算法，直接关联匹配主题中的强化学习，为带options的持续任务学习提供收敛性基础。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出理论收敛结果，未报告实验验证；收敛依赖unichain假设，具体常数与更一般假设下的表现需见正文。

papers.title: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

summary.takeaway: 提出ADiCo，用双时间尺度框架在训练中在线调节多智能体行为多样性，无需显式模型或梯度即可自适应选择多样性目标。
summary.methods: 快速时间尺度上用Diversity Control（DiCo）将系统多样性调节到目标值，慢速时间尺度上用极值搜索控制（ESC）仅凭平均回合回报调整该目标；在两个合作MARL任务的六种配置上评估。
summary.relevance: 面向合作多智能体强化学习中的协调与角色分工，对应匹配主题中的强化学习与多智能体与奖励学习。
summary.caveat: 评估仅限两个合作MARL任务的六种配置，摘要未报告统计显著性、方差或更大规模任务上的泛化性。

papers.title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

summary.takeaway: 提出并实证“回归性谄媚”现象：当用户以伪造文档反驳时，医学视觉语言模型会放弃原本正确的答案。
summary.methods: 在400个VQA-RAD是非题上构造19,200轮多轮对话，测试四个开源VLM，在有/无伪造处方及是否声明文档为合成条件下比较错误放弃率与翻转率。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态医学模型的对齐与可靠性，关联匹配主题中的多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成。
summary.caveat: 结论基于特定VQA-RAD子集、四个开源模型和构造的对话脚本，不必然推广到其他医学数据集、闭源模型或真实临床场景。

papers.title: Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

summary.takeaway: 视觉语言模型在深度线索与图像平面线索冲突时系统性偏向误导性线索，但其表示中仍可解码出正确的深度顺序。
summary.methods: 通过受控的深度—线索冲突实验（聚焦表观大小与垂直位置），在渲染场景和真实照片上比较判断、做表示分析与干预；通过对象级write-back增强模型自身深度读出，无需更新参数或真值深度标注。
summary.relevance: 研究多模态模型如何利用深度信息，关联匹配主题中的多模态学习与跨模态理解与生成。
summary.caveat: 干预效果受写入信号方向与目标token影响，且强度因架构和领域而异；摘要未说明覆盖的模型数量与外部效度。

papers.title: Beyond Corrected Actions: Training LLM Agents on Textual Critiques
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for multi-turn agentic tasks that require interactions with users and environments over extended sequences of actions. A common approach to improving LLM agents is to use more capable expert models to provide training supervision, either by behavior cloning the expert's trajectories or by using the expert to correct the actions in trajectories generated by the weaker student model. However, expert LLMs can provide richer supervision than actions alone: they can directly generate textual critique that explain why specific actions are incorrect. We study whether training on such feedback benefits LLM agents and propose Critique-Augmented Agentic Fine-Tuning (CAFT), a framework that elicits textual expert feedback on student-generated trajectories. For each incorrect action, the expert yields both a corrected action and a textual critique explaining the student's mistake--which we then use as the training target for fine-tuning. Across four student models from the Nemotron 3 and Gemma 4 families on the agentic domains $τ^2$-Bench Airline+Retail and WebShop, adding critiques to action-level supervision improves performance by 8% on average over action-only distillation. Additionally, CAFT checkpoints can also provide a better warm start for reinforcement learning than expert-trajectory distillation. Our results demonstrate that textual critiques can strengthen supervision for multi-turn LLM agents.

summary.takeaway: 提出CAFT，将专家对错误动作的文本批评与纠正动作一并作为监督目标，提升多轮LLM智能体性能。
summary.methods: 在student轨迹的每个错误动作上，由专家模型同时给出纠正动作和文本critique，并以此微调；在Nemotron 3和Gemma 4家族四个学生模型、τ²-Bench Airline+Retail与WebShop上进行评估。
summary.relevance: 面向LLM智能体训练与对齐，关联匹配主题中的大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和强化学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明critique标注成本、专家模型选择的影响及跨任务泛化；个别任务设置下的结果差异未展开。

papers.title: When Does Momentum Help in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards?
papers.abstract: Momentum is a classical tool for accelerating convex optimization and a standard component of modern large language model training. Yet recent empirical work has questioned the usefulness of first-moment momentum in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). We study this question through a bandit formulation of RLVR with bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) momentum, where the EMA coefficient $β$ controls how quickly the weights on past gradients decay. When policy gradients are evaluated exactly, we prove that increasing $β$ within a range that prevents overshoot strictly accelerates optimization. When gradients are estimated from sampled responses, a positive expected gain can be obscured by sampling fluctuations. We show that as the learning rate $η$ decreases, the expected gain with fixed $β$ vanishes faster than these fluctuations, whereas increasing $β$ to keep $η/(1-β)$ within the safe regime preserves a nonvanishing gain that eventually dominates them. Bandit simulations quantitatively validate these predictions. RLVR experiments on Qwen3-4B-Base using SGD with EMA and AdamW support our principle of choosing larger coefficients in practical LLM post-training. On Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, simply increasing $β_1$ improves mean validation accuracy by nearly $2$ percentage points over the conventional choice, demonstrating the principle's effectiveness at a larger model scale.

summary.takeaway: 从理论上有条件地支持在RLVR中使用并增大偏差校正EMA动量：可行范围内增大β可严格加速优化，采样噪声下需保持η/(1-β)在安全区间。
summary.methods: 用带偏差校正EMA动量的bandit化RLVR建模，分别分析精确策略梯度和采样估计情形，并用bandit模拟验证；在Qwen3-4B-Base（SGD+EMA与AdamW）和Qwen2.5-32B（AdamW）上做实验。
summary.relevance: 直接研究LLM后训练中的RLVR优化，关联匹配主题中的大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和强化学习。
summary.caveat: 理论基于bandit简化，实际LLM实验仅报告Qwen系列结果，摘要未给出完整消融与方差/显著性信息。

papers.title: Safe-FCL: Continual Risk Awareness and Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation for Federated Continual Learning of LLMs
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models (LLMs) to learn collaboratively from distributed client data, but malicious client updates can compromise global model safety. As federated tasks evolve, changing malicious update patterns challenge the ability of existing defenses to maintain reliable risk detection over time. To address this challenge, we propose Safe-FCL, a framework integrating continual risk awareness with fine-grained safety aggregation for federated continual learning of LLMs. Specifically, the Continual Risk Awareness (CRA) mechanism learns emerging risk patterns across sequential tasks and constrains detector updates using a protective subspace derived from historical features, mitigating forgetting of previously learned malicious patterns while adapting to new risks. To translate risk awareness into aggregation-level safety control, the Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation (FGSA) mechanism combines client-level risk assessments from CRA with module-level deviations from historical update behavior to adaptively regulate aggregation contributions, suppressing potentially malicious updates while minimizing unnecessary restrictions on benign updates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Safe-FCL outperforms current SOTA methods, improving global-model Rule and MD-Judge scores in federated continual learning by 0.41% and 0.64%, respectively, while increasing average risk recognition accuracy by 2.01%.

summary.takeaway: 提出Safe-FCL，在联邦持续微调LLM中结合持续风险感知与细粒度安全聚合，抵御随任务演化的恶意客户端更新。
summary.methods: Continual Risk Awareness（CRA）用历史特征构建保护子空间约束检测器更新以缓解遗忘；Fine-Grained Safety Aggregation（FGSA）结合客户端级风险评估与模块级偏差自适应调整聚合贡献；在联邦持续学习实验中与SOTA比较。
summary.relevance: 聚焦LLM联邦持续学习中的安全对齐，关联匹配主题中的大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和持续学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告Rule、MD-Judge与平均风险识别准确率的数值提升，未说明攻击类型范围、客户端异质性及计算开销。

papers.title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

summary.takeaway: 提出按多步episode最终成败而非当前步正确性校准智能体自报置信度，使每步置信度可预测整段rollout能否成功。
summary.methods: 在GRPO下，用同一任务的多条rollout提供成功标签，以proper scoring rule对每步置信度打分；在ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop上对Qwen2.5-7B做离线RL，并在在线ALFWorld上验证，另提出区分episode深度、任务难度与attempt级预见的评估协议。
summary.relevance: 针对LLM智能体的置信校准、弃权与人工接管，关联匹配主题中的大语言模型、检索增强与对齐和强化学习。
summary.caveat: 评估主要集中在Qwen2.5-7B与三个文本/交互环境；摘要未报告跨模型规模、跨基座模型的泛化及误弃权带来的代价。

papers.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
papers.abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.

summary.takeaway: 提出在低资源机器翻译中，当有中等量单语数据时，采用回译（BT）比继续预训练更有效，能显著提升翻译质量，甚至超过使用10倍平行数据训练的模型。
summary.methods: 使用预训练大语言模型进行微调，在少量平行语料（如1K对）基础上，利用单语数据通过回译生成合成平行对，与平行数据更新交替进行。在Odia和Swahili上评估，使用XCOMET-XXL指标，并进行盲人工评估（Odia和梵语）。
summary.relevance: 该研究与大语言模型、预训练以及低资源机器翻译相关，探索了单语数据在LLM微调中的有效利用方式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明单语数据的来源和具体规模，也未提及除Odia和Swahili外其他语言的具体结果；回译效果可能依赖于中间翻译的质量。

papers.title: Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition for Building STRATA-S12: An Open SAR-Optical Corpus for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.

summary.takeaway: 提出缺陷驱动的分层采集算法（DDSA），用于构建共配准的SAR-光学语料库，确保各分层（类别×季节×区域）的覆盖，并发布STRATA-S12语料库。
summary.methods: 将语料库构建视为约束最大覆盖问题，在半球校正的分层上进行缺陷驱动排序，强制时间配对和多阶段质量门控，并引入人在回路的缺陷修复。使用Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2数据，经过2,928,370次采集尝试，最终发布740,746对。
summary.relevance: 该工作与自监督学习、预训练以及遥感地球观测相关，提供了用于自监督预训练的多模态数据集。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出系统性的跨语料库和跨方法比较留待后续工作；修复循环虽无质量损失，但采集效率较低（尝试次数远多于发布对数）。

papers.title: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Frontier and Local LLMs Querying a Biomedical Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract: We combine GeneNetwork's 1TB structured database with its metadata as an RDF graph and an associated literature corpus. We benchmark frontier and local LLMs querying it through four architectures: document, graph and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a combination of the three. We evaluate them on 40 domain specific expert-curated questions with a new metric: the satisfaction frequency psi (psi, i.e, the share of questions answered with precision and recall of at least 70% or an f1 of at least 60%). psi ranks systems the same way precision, recall and f1 -- a machine learning metric built from the harmonic mean of precision and recall -- but is easier to read and assess for humans. System architecture had a large effect: with full use of Claude Opus 4.8 the plain document RAG of our earlier GNQA system had a psi of 36% against 86% for our new combined tools. Delegating most of the work from Claude Opus 4.8 to a local model halved query costs while still reaching a psi of 59%.

summary.takeaway: 构建了一个基于GeneNetwork知识图谱的专家 curated 基准，评估前沿和本地LLM在不同RAG架构下的查询性能，提出新指标ψ，并发现组合工具架构显著优于纯文档RAG。
summary.methods: 将GeneNetwork的1TB结构化数据库及其元数据转换为RDF图，并关联文献语料。设计四种架构：文档RAG、图RAG、代理RAG及三者组合。使用40个领域专家问题，以ψ（精确率和召回率均≥70%或F1≥60%的问题比例）为指标。
summary.relevance: 该研究涉及检索增强生成（RAG）、知识图谱和大语言模型，与匹配主题中的检索增强与对齐、知识图谱相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供不同架构的详细比较数据，仅报告了ψ值；基准问题数量较少（40个），可能限制泛化性。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph Prior-Guided Latent Adaptation for Generalizable Single-Cell Perturbation Response Prediction.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting transcriptional responses to drug perturbations in unseen cellular contexts is a central challenge in single-cell perturbation modeling. This challenge creates a need for models that combine flexible state transitions with structured biological prior knowledge. Existing data-driven models often struggle to generalize across unseen cell types, while many prior-based models rely on static biological graphs without explicitly conditioning prior influence on perturbation-specific target support. RESULTS: We propose DGP-LA, a dynamic graph-prior latent adaptation framework that refines biological priors and injects them as gated latent corrections within a cell-state-conditioned transition model. DGP-LA couples a transition backbone with perturbation-conditioned sparse graph refinement. It propagates gene-aligned target support over the refined graph and selectively injects the resulting topology-aware signal into the hidden representation. On Tahoe and NeurIPS, DGP-LA improves Pearson Delta relative to State by 8.7% and 35.8% for generalization across unseen cell types. In zero-shot drug perturbation response prediction on unseen cell types, it improves Pearson Delta relative to CRISP by 79.1% and 67.6%. The model also improves DE-gene recovery, response discrimination, and Hallmark pathway recovery, supporting adaptive latent integration of biological priors for more generalizable and biologically interpretable perturbation modeling. AVAILABILITY: DGP-LA's source code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/bieyl/DGP-LA and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22155398. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

summary.takeaway: 提出DGP-LA框架，通过动态图先验引导的潜在适应，提升单细胞扰动响应预测在未见细胞类型上的泛化能力。
summary.methods: DGP-LA结合状态转移主干和扰动条件稀疏图精炼，将基因对齐的目标支持传播到精炼图上，并选择性注入拓扑感知信号到隐藏表示。在Tahoe和NeurIPS数据集上评估，使用Pearson Delta等指标。
summary.relevance: 该研究针对单细胞扰动预测，与匹配主题中的单细胞扰动、药物扰动机制直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了相对于基线模型的相对提升，未提供绝对性能数值；模型依赖于生物先验知识，可能受先验质量影响。

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

summary.takeaway: 提出TEMPO方法，用于机器人策略的测试时自适应，通过熵正则化和基于分数的记忆机制，在部署时无需奖励信号进行在线适应。
summary.methods: TEMPO在演员-评论家框架下，仅更新演员网络，使用冻结的预训练评论家作为性能代理。引入熵促进正则化以减轻过度自信，以及优先级回放启发的记忆机制。在Go1、Go2、G1机器人上于MuJoCo Playground中测试四种偏移，并在物理Unitree Go2上验证。
summary.relevance: 该工作涉及强化学习、持续适应与预训练，与匹配主题中的强化学习、持续适应与预训练相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明计算开销的具体细节；真实世界验证仅限于单个机器人平台和特定负载变化。

papers.title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)
papers.abstract: Mid-2026 reporting on autonomous AI evaluation incidents claimed that frontier large language model (LLM) agents escaped server containment through emergent coordination and cloud infrastructure attacks. This paper contextualizes those claims through forensic analysis and containerized recreation of both the Highly Persistent Internal Model (HPIM) training-case conditions and the Phase One privilege escalation targeting internal package repositories during OpenAI's ExploitGym evaluations. We recreate the configuration of the OpenAI-provided training example and reproduce the cryptographic verification bypass (CVE-2026-65616) in isolated repository servers, where misconfigured systems enabled token forgery and privilege escalation through basic HTTP requests, Python, and JavaScript. Crucially, the training-example conditions and the Phase One (and later) misconfigurations share the same exploitable patterns. Our analysis explains how Zero Trust Architecture principles neutralize this shared attack vector. Contemporary AI risks derive directly from training and deployment conditions in ambivalent learning environments lacking adequate containment measures.

summary.takeaway: 通过取证分析和容器化重现，研究了RL/RLHF训练中可能导致的AI代理权限提升问题（CVE-2026-65616），指出训练和部署条件中的可攻击模式，并强调零信任架构的缓解作用。
summary.methods: 重现了OpenAI ExploitGym评估中的训练案例条件和第一阶段权限提升，在隔离的仓库服务器中复现了密码验证绕过漏洞，使用了HTTP请求、Python和JavaScript。
summary.relevance: 该研究与大语言模型、多智能体与奖励学习相关，探讨了RL/RLHF训练中的安全风险。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供漏洞利用的详细技术步骤或修复方案的具体评估；分析基于特定训练案例，可能不覆盖所有潜在攻击向量。

papers.title: Learning Perception to Action Rules through Reinforcement Learning for Theory-of-Mind Reasoning
papers.abstract: In Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning, large language models may correctly infer the agent's mental state but fail to use that inference when predicting or judging the agent's subsequent actions. In this work, we investigate whether explicitly connecting perception, belief, and action with rules improves ToM reasoning. We generate concise \textit{if--then} rules that express relations between perception to action and use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train Qwen2.5 and Llama3 models across four ToM benchmarks. GRPO with rule generation outperforms prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and think reasoning. Moreover, rules generated by larger models ($\geq$3B) provide transferable knowledge that improves downstream performance of GPT-4o-mini. These findings suggest that explicit rules help models bridge the reasoning gap in ToM and support knowledge transfer across models.

summary.takeaway: 提出通过生成简洁的if-then规则，并使用GRPO训练模型，以提升心智理论（ToM）推理中从感知到行动的连接，促进知识迁移。
summary.methods: 生成表达感知到行动关系的if-then规则，使用GRPO训练Qwen2.5和Llama3模型，在四个ToM基准上评估。规则由≥3B模型生成，并测试其对GPT-4o-mini的迁移效果。
summary.relevance: 该研究涉及大语言模型和强化学习，与匹配主题中的大语言模型、强化学习相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明规则生成的具体过程和质量控制；评估仅限于四个ToM基准，可能不覆盖所有ToM场景。

papers.title: A perturbation atlas of mouse neural organoids resolves macroglial reactivity and nominates drivers of degeneration
papers.abstract: Understanding neuro-glial roles in homeostasis and disease requires scalable central nervous system (CNS) models, particularly as macroglia like astrocytes and Muller glia remain challenging to study in slow-developing human systems. Here, we generate and map the cellular diversity of mouse neural organoids spanning multiple brain regions and the retina. Benchmarking transcriptomic maturation against in vivo references captures postnatal neuro-macroglial states within a month. We show that macroglia are highly responsive to inflammatory cues and adopt specific transcriptomic states also found in vivo. Through a single-cell perturbation screen targeting 13 Muller-glia-specific pathways, we map how certain inflammatory cytokines drive degeneration-like stress programs in photoreceptors and distinct reactive states in Muller glia, including an Oncostatin M-driven chaperone-associated state. Mechanistically, we identify gp130-STAT3 signaling as a targetable driver of macroglial reactivity and photoreceptor distress. Together, these single-cell atlases provide a foundation for dissecting cellular crosstalk and neuro-glial pathology in the mature CNS.

summary.takeaway: 构建了小鼠神经类器官的扰动图谱，揭示了巨胶质细胞的反应性状态，并提名了退化驱动因子，如gp130-STAT3信号。
summary.methods: 生成覆盖多个脑区和视网膜的小鼠神经类器官，通过单细胞扰动筛选靶向13个Muller胶质细胞特异性通路，结合转录组成熟度基准，分析炎症细胞因子驱动的退化样应激程序。
summary.relevance: 该研究涉及单细胞扰动、多组学扰动，与匹配主题中的单细胞扰动、多组学扰动相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供扰动筛选的详细规模或统计显著性；结果基于小鼠模型，向人类转化的适用性需进一步验证。

papers.title: ReaDy: Recurrent States as Dynamic Context for Speculative Drafting in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

summary.takeaway: 提出ReaDy，据称是首个利用混合线性注意力（HLA）模型循环状态为推测解码提供位置特定上下文的推测解码方法。
summary.methods: 每个草稿位置用学习到的查询从目标模型已提交的循环状态中检索补充上下文，由轻量state reader通过残差更新注入草稿表示，并采用低秩状态读取与融合算子控制开销；基于DSpark的并行骨干与顺序预测头，配合轻量两阶段适配策略，并通过消融考察reader容量、状态来源与残差位置；在数学、代码生成、对话共七个基准上测试。
summary.relevance: 直接关系到大语言模型推理加速与推测解码，并涉及HLA这一高效注意力架构。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明对比基线是否为同一目标模型、草稿模型的独立性约束，以及3.16×加速与7.97%吞吐提升的具体测量条件；HLA循环状态是否完整保留历史信息也未讨论。

papers.title: SPARS: A Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection Framework for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, updating shared parameters when learning new tasks often overwrites existing knowledge, causing catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting but rely on previous samples, raising privacy, memory, and scalability concerns. On the other hand, parameter isolation-based methods preserve learned knowledge but may limit knowledge transfer, whereas regularization promotes adaptability but remains susceptible to interference between old and new tasks. To maintain the stability-plasticity trade-off, this paper proposes Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection (SPARS), a replay-free hybrid framework combining global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization. SPARS estimates parameter importance using either the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) or a novel Confidence Score (CS) estimator that leverages logit sensitivity and achieves comparable performance to FIM without requiring labelled data. Based on parameter importance, SPARS partitions parameters into three importance-aware regions namely, winning, neighboring, and non-important parameter regions. Each region receives a different adaptation strategy: selective freezing, soft regularization, or unrestricted learning based on its role in the stability-plasticity trade-off. To mitigate classifier bias in class-incremental learning, we employ Quadratic Discriminant Analysis to improve performance on previously learned classes .Experiments on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet demonstrate consistent improvement in average incremental accuracy over existing isolation- and regularization-based methods across task- and class-incremental learning. On TinyImageNet, SPARS achieves the best performance with 6% improvement for class-incremental learning while retaining over 60% of parameters for future tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出SPARS，一种免回放的混合持续学习框架，通过参数重要性将参数划分为三个区域并施以不同的适应策略以平衡稳定性与可塑性。
summary.methods: 用Fisher信息矩阵或无需标签的新Confidence Score估计参数重要性，把参数分为winning、neighboring、non-important三类，分别采用选择性冻结、软正则化或无限制学习；在类增量学习中用二次判别分析缓解分类器偏置；在CIFAR-10与TinyImageNet上做任务增量和类增量实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与稳定性—可塑性权衡，属于匹配主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出准确率与参数量保留的具体对比数值（仅提及TinyImageNet类增量提升6%、保留超60%参数用于未来任务），也未说明评估的任务序列长度与是否与基于回放的方法公平比较。

papers.title: Quantifying privacy risks in foundation model representations of brain MRI
papers.abstract: Pretrained representations are increasingly used to share and reuse information from medical images without exposing the original scans, but it is unclear how much patient-specific information these representations retain. We investigate this question for brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) by evaluating five frozen pretrained encoders spanning different architectures, pretraining objectives, and training domains on two longitudinal T1-weighted datasets, OASIS-2 and MIRIAD. Under an attacker model with access to released embeddings, the corresponding public encoder, and auxiliary MRI scans, we evaluate patient linkage and sensitive-attribute inference. Across the evaluated representations, we observe substantial subject-specific information: rank-1 patient linkage reaches up to 99\% on MIRIAD and exceeds 90\% on OASIS-2 for the highest-risk representation, despite the absence of an identification objective during encoder training. We further show that the released embeddings retain information about a demographic attribute, with recorded-sex prediction reaching balanced accuracy of 90.9\% on OASIS-2 and 95.5\% on MIRIAD. Overall, our results demonstrate that replacing raw brain MRI with learned embeddings does not, by itself, eliminate patient-linkage or attribute-inference risk, and is therefore insufficient on its own to establish anonymity.

summary.takeaway: 实证表明，用预训练编码器输出的脑MRI嵌入替代原始扫描本身并不能消除患者关联与敏感属性推断风险。
summary.methods: 在OASIS-2与MIRIAD两个纵向T1加权数据集上评估五个冻结预训练编码器，覆盖不同架构、预训练目标与训练域；在攻击者拥有已发布嵌入、对应公开编码器和辅助MRI扫描的威胁模型下，评估患者关联与敏感属性推断。
summary.relevance: 与预训练、自监督表示学习相关，关心表示中泄露的隐私信息。
summary.caveat: 攻击设定假设攻击者掌握公开编码器与辅助扫描，可能高估现实风险；摘要未报告置信区间、编码器训练数据与下游评估的独立性，以及不同编码器间的风险对比细节。

papers.title: Dataset-Level Regularization for Joint-Embedding Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Self-supervised joint embedding learning aligns representations of augmented views while regularizing their distribution to prevent collapse. Regularization aims to shape the overall representation distribution, but most joint embedding methods restrict its computation to the active minibatch. We propose out-of-batch regularization, which maintains a dataset-level state in CPU memory and uses globally constructed per-instance targets during minibatch training. Evaluated on natural images and biomedical datasets, these anchors approximate the full-dataset regularization gradient more faithfully than conventional minibatch estimation at small batch sizes. Applications to contrastive (SimCLR) and non-contrastive (SIGReg) approaches show consistent improvement over the corresponding in-batch objectives for image classification, minority-class performance under controlled imbalance, instance retrieval, and continued self-supervised pretraining, with the largest gains at small batch sizes. These results suggest that dataset-level regularization can be decoupled from minibatch optimization, making batch size an optimization choice that does not affect the geometry of the regularizer.

summary.takeaway: 提出out-of-batch正则化，用CPU内存中的数据集级状态在minibatch训练时构造全局逐实例目标，将正则化的几何与批量大小解耦。
summary.methods: 维护数据集级状态并生成全局构造的逐实例目标，在自然图像与生物医学数据集上评估；应用于对比方法SimCLR与非对比方法SIGReg，测图像分类、受控不平衡下的少数类性能、实例检索与继续自监督预训练。
summary.relevance: 直接对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，关注联合嵌入学习中的坍缩正则化。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明CPU内存状态与minibatch梯度的近似误差界限，也未给出在大批量下是否仍优于传统估计；数据集级状态随数据规模增长的内存成本未讨论。

papers.title: TEX-MEX: Similarity-Guided Temporal Contrastive Learning for Time Series
papers.abstract: Contrastive learning for time series depends on deciding which pairs of inputs should be treated as similar and dissimilar. Because few augmentations reliably preserve meaning in time series, prior methods have relied on two disjoint notions of similarity between windows: structural similarity, which relates windows with similar morphology, and temporal similarity, which relates windows that occur close together in time. We introduce TEX-MEX, to our knowledge the first approach to unify the two into a single relationship. Given a random batch of windows drawn across the dataset, TEX-MEX uses the encoder to identify which windows are structurally similar or dissimilar to each other. It then pulls each window toward the temporally shifted versions of similar windows and pushes it away from those of dissimilar ones, learning what typically accompanies similar windows in time. Across PPG, EEG, ECG, accelerometry, and continuous glucose monitoring, TEX-MEX broadly achieves state-of-the-art performance against contrastive, reconstructive, JEPA-based, and modality-specific approaches, establishing it as a strong general SSL objective. We further train a 560K-parameter PPG foundation model that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a broad range of downstream benchmarks while being roughly 50x smaller than the next-best unimodally pretrained PPG foundation model in our evaluation. We will release this foundation model open-source and open-weight to the community to support future work and practical applications.

summary.takeaway: 提出TEX-MEX，据称首次将时间序列中结构相似性与时间相似性统一为单一关系的对比学习目标。
summary.methods: 对随机窗口批次，用编码器判定结构相似或不相似的窗口，将每个窗口拉近相似窗口的时间偏移版本、推远不相似窗口的偏移版本；在PPG、EEG、ECG、加速度计与连续血糖监测数据上，与对比、重建、JEPA类及模态专用方法比较，并训练560K参数的PPG基础模型。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习，关注时间序列的通用SSL目标。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明时间偏移量的选择方式及其敏感性，也未给出560K模型与50倍更小这一比较的具体基准与指标；'状态最优'仅由摘要自述，缺少数值细节。

papers.title: Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.

summary.takeaway: 对RAG系统配置问题进行首个大规模实证研究，给出症状、根因、相关阶段与修复模式的完整分类，并提出九条可操作建议。
summary.methods: 从10个不同的RAG系统收集654个真实配置问题，按症状、根因、阶段与修复模式归纳分类，并分析症状出现阶段与根因阶段的关系。
summary.relevance: 直接对应大语言模型与检索增强生成，关注RAG系统的配置可靠性与调试。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明10个系统与654个问题的选取标准、是否覆盖所有主流RAG架构，也未量化分类的一致性或统计显著性。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
papers.abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.

summary.takeaway: 提出DKGI，一种让语言模型智能体直接在完整节点与边文件之上创建图访问工具、使工具创建与使用协同演化的框架。
summary.methods: 智能体编写Python代码沿关系遍历、组合节点集并选择文本证据，与shell搜索和文件检查交替执行；执行反馈指导工具创建与修订；在三个领域的基准数据集上做无训练评估，并进行受控消融比较多轮编程与仅shell访问及预定义图工具。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与知识图谱，涉及智能体工具使用与文本丰富图检索。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明基准数据集名称、Hit@1提升是否来自同一智能体与提示设置，也未讨论直接文件访问在超大图上的可扩展性与安全性。

papers.title: Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

summary.takeaway: 提出将Experience Packing and Replay与脉冲激活图（SAM）结合，用显著性引导的回放提升深度脉冲神经网络在低延迟约束下的持续学习表现。
summary.methods: 将Batch Normalization Through Time稳定的VGG9 SNN与基于脉冲活动的SAM结合，把SAM在时间上聚合成空间注意力图，用于选择信息量最大的图像块进行回放而非存储完整图像；在Split CIFAR10与Split CIFAR100上评估准确率—内存权衡。
summary.relevance: 对应持续学习主题，同时涉及脉冲神经网络这一能效架构。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称'提升准确率—内存权衡'且'保持竞争力'，未给出具体准确率数值、内存预算与回放比例；也未与更广泛的持续学习方法在同等低延迟约束下比较。

papers.title: Benchmarking Self-Supervised 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models and Transferability Estimation
papers.abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has expanded the pool of 3D medical foundation models, but published evaluations use different datasets, endpoints and fine-tuning protocols. Models also differ in architecture, pretraining objective and data, while downstream targets range from voxel-level masks to patient-level diagnoses and outcomes. As a result, published findings provide little directly comparable evidence for choosing a model for a new task. Direct comparison of adaptation performance requires fine-tuning candidates on labelled target data, at substantial computational cost. We benchmark 23 candidates across the same 14 segmentation, classification and regression tasks spanning multiple anatomies and modalities. No candidate ranked among the top three across all segmentation tasks or across all classification and regression tasks; a convolutional encoder could outperform a transformer trained with the same objective on one task but underperform it on another. We benchmark transferability estimators against the fine-tuned rankings and find that their agreement varies across dense segmentation, classification and regression. InsightRank uses task-appropriate frozen-feature statistics and architecture-aware pairwise comparisons to rank candidates before fine-tuning. Across the 23-model pool, mean Kendall tau-b was 0.431 for segmentation and 0.352 for classification and regression. The segmentation Top 3 contained a task winner on four of nine tasks; the image-level Top 3 contained none on the five tasks, despite better full-ranking agreement than the matched conventional estimators. A three-model shortlist reduced recorded extraction-plus-training job time by 85.8% across seven segmentation tasks. Together, the benchmark provides a common reference for model selection and InsightRank offers a lower-cost way to prioritize fine-tuning, with shortlist performance that differs by target type.

summary.takeaway: 在同一套14项3D医学分割、分类与回归任务上基准测试了23个自监督3D医学基础模型，发现没有模型能在所有任务上稳定领先，并提出InsightRank迁移性估计器以较低成本对候选模型进行排序。
summary.methods: 在14个跨解剖与模态的分割、分类和回归任务上统一评估23个候选模型；对比多种迁移性估计器与微调后的真实排名的一致性；InsightRank使用任务适配的冻结特征统计和架构感知的成对比较进行候选排序，并在7项分割任务上评估三模型候选短名单的任务耗时缩减。
summary.relevance: 直接对应“预训练”与“自监督与表示学习”主题，为在多种下游任务中选择自监督预训练的3D医学基础模型提供了统一基准和低成本的迁移性估计方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示候选短名单的性能因目标类型而异：图像级Top 3在五个分类/回归任务中没有包含任何任务最优模型，且Top 3在分割任务中仅部分命中任务最优；因此其排序可靠性有限，不能替代完整微调评估。

papers.title: Latent causal diffusions for single-cell perturbation modeling.
papers.abstract: Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

summary.takeaway: 提出潜在因果扩散（LCD）生成模型，将单细胞基因表达建模为测量噪声下的平稳扩散过程，并在预测未见扰动组合的分布偏移方面优于已有方法，同时学习基因调控的机制性动态系统。
summary.methods: 构建LCD生成模型以捕捉单细胞RNA测序扰动筛选中的转录组响应；提出CLIPR方法对学习到的扩散动态进行因果线性化，从而近似所有基因间的直接因果效应；在模拟系统和全基因组扰动筛选上验证因果结构恢复。
summary.relevance: 对应“单细胞扰动”与“机制推理”主题，将生成式建模与因果推断结合，用于预测未见扰动效应并推断调控机制。
summary.caveat: CLIPR的因果效应可识别性依赖于线性漂移假设；摘要未说明在非线性或更复杂真实系统下该假设的适用范围，也未报告在全部可能扰动场景中的泛化限制。

papers.title: Perturb-Seqr: Signature Search Engine Integrating Connectivity Mapping Resources
papers.abstract: High-throughput transcriptomics can be used to develop Connectivity Mapping resources for identifying potential reversers and mimickers of disease signatures for drug and target discovery. Recently, several new Connectivity Mapping datasets have emerged, but no efforts were made so far to evaluate and integrate them. Motivated by this opportunity, we have developed Perturb-Seqr, a comprehensive Connectivity Mapping search engine that integrates nine small molecule transcriptomics Connectivity Maps and seven single gene perturbation followed by expression Connectivity Maps. Specifically, Perturb-Seqr contains processed data from LINCS (L1000), Tahoe-100M, Novartis Institute for Biomedical Research (DRUG-seq), the original CMap (cDNA microarrays), Ginkgo Bioworks (DRUG-seq), SciPlex (scRNA-seq), DeepCover MoA (PISA proteomics), Perturb Atlas (RNA-seq), Replogle et al. (Perturb-seq), CREEDS (cDNA microarrays), CM4AI (Perturb-seq), and RummaGEO (RNA-seq). To serve these Connectivity Maps in one unifying search engine, we converted the expression signatures from these resources into 450,271 gene sets of up- and down-regulated genes measuring the effects of 9,856 unique drug and 17,643 unique gene perturbations, targeting 917 cell lines and cell types. We demonstrate how Perturb-Seqr, and the gene sets it serves, can be used to identify targets for drugs and drugs for targets, uncover new pathways, and identify potential side effects for preclinical compounds. Overall, Perturb-Seqr is a comprehensive up-to-date Connectivity Mapping search engine and database, enabling the discovery of new drugs and targets. Perturb-Seqr is accessible from: https://perturbseqr.maayanlab.cloud/.

summary.takeaway: 开发了Perturb-Seqr，一个整合九个\u5c0f\u5206\u5b50\u8f6c\u5f55\u7ec4\u8fde\u63a5\u56fe\u548c\u4e03\u4e2a\u5355\u57fa\u56e0\u5e72\u6270\u8868\u8fbe\u8fde\u63a5\u56fe\u7684\u7efc\u5408\u6027Connectivity Mapping搜索\u5f15\u64ce\uff0c\u7528\u4e8e\u8bc6\u522b\u75be\u75c5\u7b7e\u540d\u7684\u6f5c\u5728\u9006\u8f6c\u5242\u4e0e\u6a21\u4eff\u5242\u3002
summary.methods: 整合LINCS L1000、Tahoe-100M、Novartis DRUG-seq、原始CMap、Ginkgo Bioworks DRUG-seq、SciPlex、DeepCover MoA、Perturb Atlas、Replogle等、CREEDS、CM4AI和RummaGEO等资源；将表达签名转换为450,271个上调和下调基因集，覆盖9,856种药物和17,643个基因扰动，涉及917个细胞系和细胞类型；并提供基于网页的搜索引擎。
