summary.relevance: 对应“单细胞扰动”主题，提供跨多个扰动筛选资源的统一搜索与数据整合平台，用于药物和靶点发现。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告该搜索引擎的检索准确性、召回率或与其他Connectivity Mapping方法的定量比较；也未说明不同来源数据标准化和批次效应处理对结果可靠性的影响。

papers.title: Concurrent de novo inference of cell types and gene regulatory networks with NetMap
papers.abstract: Existing methods for GRN inference based on single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data typically require prior cell type calling and then infer GRNs at cell type resolution. This risks propagation of errors from cell annotation to GRN inference. Moreover, it makes existing methods blind to regulatory programs that are shared between different cell types, as well as to subtle differences in regulatory activity between cells of the same type. To address these limitations, we present NetMap, a pipeline that jointly infers cell-level GRNs and clusters cells based on shared regulatory programs, combining state-of-the-art single-cell autoencoders and explainable artificial intelligence methods. NetMap outperforms existing methods on synthetic data with a known ground-truth GRN and is able to reliably detect biologically plausible regulons on real data. Moreover, requiring only a small set of user-provided marker genes, NetMap can be used for GRN structure-informed probabilistic cell type assignment. We demonstrate the utility of this approach using PBMC data, where we achieve near perfect clustering and cell type recovery performance compared with manually created cell type labels. Finally, we applied NetMap to a data set with naive, activated and exhausted T-cells, and were able to verify that NetMap retrieves relevant T-cell state signatures from the data, with two approaches. NetMap can be installed as a python package from https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap and is compatible with the scverse system. Scripts to reproduce our results can be found at https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap-evaluation.

summary.takeaway: 提出NetMap流程，可同时推断细胞水平基因调控网络并基于共享调控程序对细胞聚类，避免先进行细胞类型注释再推断GRN所带来的误差传播，并能识别跨细胞类型的共享调控程序。
summary.methods: 结合最先进的单细胞自编码器和可解释人工智能方法，联合推断细胞水平GRN和细胞聚类；在具有已知真实GRN的合成数据上评估；在PBMC和naive/activated/exhausted T细胞等真实数据上测试；仅需少量用户提供的标记基因即可进行GRN结构信息指导的概率性细胞类型分配。
summary.relevance: 对应“GRN / Regulon”主题，提出不依赖先验细胞类型注释的GRN推断与细胞聚类联合方法，并展示其在免疫细胞状态识别中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在合成数据和部分真实数据集上的表现，未说明计算可扩展性、对超参数或标记基因选择的敏感性，也未提供与其他GRN推断方法在更多组织或疾病数据上的系统比较。

papers.title: Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model's primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.

summary.takeaway: 研究发现分割基础模型（SAM2）在分割任务执行中产生的对象指针可作为一种可迁移表示，用于下游肿瘤预测，且任务引导的对象指针在癌症类型分类上优于传统编码器迁移和放射组学。
summary.methods: 在两项PET/CT肿瘤预测任务上，研究SAM2对象指针作为下游表示的迁移能力；比较仅用分割监督学习的对象指针、任务引导对象指针、传统基于编码器的迁移和放射组学特征；对表示与可解释放射组学特征的关联、类别依赖的组织结构和肿瘤区域空间定位进行分析。
summary.relevance: 对应“预训练”主题，探索分割基础模型除编码器特征外的对象级表示在下游医学任务中的迁移性，为预训练模型的特征利用提供替代思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告两项PET/CT肿瘤预测任务的结果，未说明是否可推广到其他模态、器官或任务；任务引导对象指针在较难的复发预测任务上不如仅分割监督的对象指针，提示任务依赖性。

papers.title: Continual Learning for Reliable In-Sequence Molecular Communication
papers.abstract: This paper considers reliable in-sequence molecular communication, where bio-nanomachines exchange molecule-encoded information in a specified order, and investigates a new simulation-based method to incrementally evaluate communication protocols by gradually increasing the complexity of experimental settings. The proposed method, called Affine Memory Replay (AMR), builds a continual learning (CL) model to estimate communication performance between bio-nanomachines. AMR stores past simulation samples and synthesizes additional replay samples through interpolation and extrapolation between past samples. Through incremental performance estimation tasks, it replays both past and synthetic samples to regularize model updates, helping the model adapt to new experimental settings while retaining knowledge from earlier ones. Experimental results show that AMR significantly outperforms existing CL methods in maintaining overall estimation accuracy across sequentially learned estimation tasks. It effectively balances memory stability and learning plasticity under moderate training cost.

summary.takeaway: 针对按序分子通信中通信协议可靠评估问题，提出Affine Memory Replay（AMR）持续学习方法，通过重放过去仿真样本及插值/外推合成样本，在逐步复杂化的实验设置中保持估计精度。
summary.methods: AMR存储过去仿真样本，并通过过去样本间的插值和 extrapolation 合成额外重放样本；在增量性能估计任务中重放过去与合成样本以正则化模型更新；实验比较AMR与已有持续学习方法在顺序学习任务中的整体估计准确率。
summary.relevance: 对应“持续学习”主题，提出一种面向分子通信协议评估的持续学习策略，平衡记忆稳定性和学习可塑性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明仿真实验规模、基准协议数量、AMR对插值/外推合成样本质量的敏感性，也未报告在真实生物纳米机器场景或非仿真环境下的验证结果。

papers.title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Agents build knowledge graphs as memory, and building them has become easy. Maintaining them has not. When a source is retracted, overruled, or erased, everything built on top of it (entity merges, entailed edges, community summaries) must be re-examined, and the maintainer must choose between deleting too much and too little. Deployed pipelines delete only the directly extracted facts: on our corpus that reduces contaminated queries from 32.2% to 28.0% under a real retraction and changes nothing under predicate revocation. Rebuilding is no repair for a constructor that samples: two builds of the same 300-document corpus differ in 29,475 artifacts, five times the 6,248 that removing the 61 retracted documents changes. PolyGraph instead asks the constructor for receipts: for every artifact, alternative bundles of source evidence, each claimed sufficient on its own, emitted in the call that creates it. Cleanup is then set arithmetic over the receipts, with no model calls. Because receipts are the model's own self-report, a re-derivation audit checks them by deleting the cited evidence and testing whether the constructor still produces the artifact. The audit finds that a receipt is trustworthy when it is shaped like the claim it backs. Merge receipts, each backing one narrow claim, agree with re-derivation 68% and 85% of the time. Summary receipts, elicited per sentence but stored as one flat list for the whole text, are wrong about two thirds of the time, almost always by keeping dead content. One receipt per sentence instead is 100% and 88% faithful and lets cleanup keep 33 of 35 touched summaries. The result holds under a second oracle model, a claim-blind prompt, ten further deletions, a second domain and a second constructor. Distrusting the summary layer cuts contaminated queries to 0.4% and 0.8% at 99.8 to 100% of the recall a perfect maintainer would return.

summary.takeaway: 提出PolyGraph方法，要求构建器为知识图谱中的每个工件生成\u201c收据\u201d（即替代性来源证据包），从而在来源被撤回或否定时以集合运算方式进行低成本清理，避免删除过多或过少。
summary.methods: 在构建每个工件时生成替代证据包作为收据；清理时对收据进行集合运算，无需模型调用；通过重推导审计检验收据可信度，即删除被引用证据后测试构建器是否仍产生该工件；在多个语料、领域、构建器、oracle模型和提示设置下评估。
summary.relevance: 对应“知识图谱”主题，关注代理构建的知识图谱的可信维护与来源撤回后的清理问题。
summary.caveat: 收据可信度取决于其形式是否匹配所支持的声明：合并收据与重推导一致率为68%和85%，而摘要收据错误率约三分之二；因此该方法对收据设计和存储方式敏感，并非所有收据都可靠。

papers.title: Understanding when and how knowledge graphs add value to EHR-based clinical prediction across Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, and chronic pain
papers.abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) have emerged as a promising approach for incorporating biological knowledge into machine-learning models trained on electronic health record (EHR) data. However, their large scale and heterogeneous structure impose substantial computational cost, and it remains unclear whether their benefits generalize across diseases or depend on how the graph is constructed. We systematically evaluated KG integration across three diseases spanning distinct biological and clinical characteristics: multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, and chronic pain. For each disease we compared five modelling strategies, spanning EHR-only features and graph diffusion over concept-level, cohort-derived, disease-anchored, and full SPOKE (Scalable Precision Medicine Open Knowledge Engine) subgraphs, asking whether graph construction affects predictive performance and computational cost, whether KG integration improves classification over EHR-only models, and what the graph does to model behavior. Cohort-derived subgraphs, comprising roughly 45% of SPOKE's nodes and one-fifth of its edges, matched or modestly exceeded the full graph's performance while substantially reducing computational cost in all three diseases. The predictive benefit of KG integration, however, was strongly disease-dependent: it improved classification in Parkinson's disease, had no measurable effect in multiple sclerosis, and reduced performance in chronic pain. These differences were not explained by the amount of biological information incorporated: the disease with the largest shift toward molecular features showed no improvement, the sole beneficiary showed only a modest shift, and the disease with no molecular shift was penalized. Mechanistically, graph diffusion redistributed each disease's existing signal across many correlated features rather than adding independent biological signal, so that any gain depended on whether it added information beyond the EHR. These findings show that cohort-derived subgraphs offer a computationally efficient alternative to full-scale knowledge graphs, and that KG integration functions less as a universal accuracy booster than as a data- and disease-dependent transformation of the patient representation.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估了在三种疾病中把生物医学知识图谱整合到基于电子健康记录的临床预测模型的效果，发现队列衍生的子图能以更低计算成本达到或略超完整SPOKE图谱的性能，但KG带来的预测收益高度依赖疾病类型。
summary.methods: 针对多发性硬化、帕金森病和慢性疼痛，比较五种建模策略：仅EHR特征，以及在概念级、队列衍生、疾病锚定和完整SPOKE子图上的图扩散；评估图构建对预测性能和计算成本的影响，以及图扩散对模型行为的影响。
summary.relevance: 对应“知识图谱”主题，系统检验知识图谱在不同疾病EHR预测中的附加价值及其与图构建方式、计算成本的关系。
summary.caveat: KG整合的预测收益强烈依赖疾病：在帕金森病中改善分类，在多发性硬化中无可测量效果，在慢性疼痛中降低性能；且收益不能由纳入生物信息的多少解释。因此结果不能推广为KG普遍提升EHR预测性能。

papers.title: Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation: a framework for the faithful assessment of genetic perturbation target identification
papers.abstract: Identifying which gene drives a desired cell-state transition is a foundational inverse problem in target discovery and cell-state engineering, yet far less developed than forward prediction. We show that prevailing benchmarks inflate performance through two artefacts: training leakage, where test-perturbation cells are seen during fitting, and evaluation leakage, where the perturbed gene's own expression change exposes the answer. Here, we introduce Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation (CEE), a framework that separates train and test perturbation targets, removes target-gene self-effects from expression profiles and scores candidates in downstream response space. With CEE, we find that simple structure-based methods consistently outperform complex deep learning models across 16 single-cell perturbation datasets, revealing that the recoverable signal is governed by low-rank and additive structure in perturbation responses rather than by model complexity. Our work disentangles evaluation artefacts from genuine predictive capacity and offers a design principle for developing perturbation target identification methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation（CEE）框架，指出既有基准因训练泄漏和评估泄漏而虚高性能，并在去除这些伪迹后发现简单结构方法在 16 个单细胞扰动数据集上持续优于复杂深度学习模型。
summary.methods: 设计 CEE 框架，通过分离训练与测试扰动靶标、从表达谱中移除目标基因自身效应、在下游响应空间中对候选打分来评估扰动靶标识别；在 16 个单细胞扰动数据集上比较简单结构方法与复杂深度学习模型。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接针对单细胞扰动研究中的扰动靶标识别问题，揭示评估伪迹并给出更忠实的评估设计原则，与“单细胞扰动”主题高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体数据集名称、模型名称、性能数值或统计细节；结论基于摘要所述 16 个单细胞扰动数据集，未说明其覆盖范围与外部验证情况。
